title: Advogado Jr.
description:
Job description

Que tal trabalhar em uma empresa mediatech, multinacional, considerada uma das líderes mundiais no mercado de entretenimento digital?

Estamos em 15 países e, no Brasil, temos escritórios no Rio de Janeiro e em São Paulo.

Aqui na Webedia , temos um compromisso com o sucesso e contamos com profissionais brilhantes para compor nosso time.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Advogado(a) Júnior para integrar o time jurídico da Webedia Brasil, uma das líderes globais em mídia digital e produção de conteúdo. Aqui, você terá a chance de atuar em projetos inovadores que envolvem grandes marcas, influenciadores, campanhas publicitárias, eventos, conteúdos audiovisuais e o universo de plataformas digitais.

Nosso time jurídico atua como parceiro estratégico de diversas áreas da empresa, buscando soluções criativas, seguras e alinhadas com a legislação aplicável. Trabalhamos com autonomia, espírito colaborativo e muita vontade de aprender e evoluir juntos.

Se você se interessa por direito digital, propriedade intelectual, contratos e os desafios jurídicos de um ecossistema em constante transformação, venha conversar com a gente!

#VempraWebedia


Main responsibilities

Como Advogado(a) Júnior na Webedia, você atuará em parceria com diversas áreas da empresa, assessorando juridicamente projetos inovadores e desafiadores do ecossistema digital. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Apoiar a análise, elaboração e revisão de contratos diversos, como: contratos de publicidade, licenciamento de direitos autorais, prestação de serviços, parcerias, influenciadores, eventos, tecnologia e uso de imagem.
  • Realizar pesquisas jurídicas e acompanhar atualizações legislativas e regulatórias, especialmente nas áreas de propriedade intelectual, direito digital, LGPD, mídia e publicidade.
  • Auxiliar na gestão e organização dos documentos jurídicos e sistemas internos de controle.
  • Apoiar o time em temas de direito societário e corporativo, como atas, procurações e obrigações regulatórias.
  • Interagir com áreas como comercial, conteúdo, marketing, RH e tecnologia, oferecendo orientação jurídica preventiva e estratégica.
  • Auxiliar na gestão de processos administrativos, notificações e demandas judiciais, em conjunto com escritórios parceiros.

Requirements and skills

O que você precisa ter ou saber?

  • Formação completa em Direito, com registro ativo na OAB.
  • De 1 a 3 anos de experiência jurídica, preferencialmente em escritórios ou empresas com atuação nas áreas de mídia, tecnologia, entretenimento, contratos ou propriedade intelectual.
  • Boa capacidade de redação e revisão contratual.
  • Conhecimento básico em propriedade intelectual, direito digital, LGPD e/ou publicidade é um diferencial.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado (para leitura, revisão e redação de contratos).
  • Perfil proativo, comunicativo, organizado e com boa capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência prévia com contratos de publicidade digital, branded content, produção de eventos, licenciamento de conteúdo ou influenciadores.
  • Familiaridade com o ecossistema de mídia, entretenimento, agências ou plataformas digitais.
  • Conhecimento prático da LGPD e sua aplicação em projetos de marketing e dados.
  • Atuação anterior em in-house legal em empresas de tecnologia, startups ou veículos de comunicação.
  • Vivência com propriedade intelectual, direitos de imagem, direito autoral ou audiovisual.
  • Espanhol e/ou francês para comunicação com times e parceiros internacionais.
  • Interesse por cultura pop, audiovisual, games, gastronomia ou outros temas do universo Webedia.

Additional information

Estamos trabalhando no formato híbrido e seu local de trabalho será no Centro do Rio de Janeiro#021 #WebediaBrasil

Benefícios:

Seguro de Vida Metlife ;

️️ Quer um incentivo na academia? A Wellhub (Gympass) e a TotalPass pode te ajudar;

️Para cuidar da sua saúde emocional, conte com a Wellz;

Nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido tá? 3 dias por semana no escritório e 2 dias em home office;

Para te acolher desde o início, temos nosso Onboarding com aquelas orientações essenciais pra quem tá chegando juntamente com o tão esperado kit de boas vindas ;

No dress code - Amamos diversidade… Tenha liberdade para ser quem você é!

Quer Mais? Então que tal …

  • SafeSpace - é o canal de escuta da Webedia que nos ajuda a identificar e resolver problemas de conduta, esclarecer conflitos de interesses e ouvir a todos com o objetivo de ajudar a cultivar um ambiente de trabalho mais seguro e inclusivo para todas as pessoas.
  • Comitê de Ética - Comitê independente que tem o objetivo de ajudar a identificar e resolver problemas de conduta, esclarecer conflitos de interesses e ouvir vocês sobre questões relacionadas à ética e respeito na Webedia.
  • Live com CEO - Papos periódicos com o CEO, COO e diretores para alinhamento de diretrizes e atualizações sobre a empresa com todos os colaboradores.
  • Webedia Academy - Em 2022 lançamos a Webedia Academy, a plataforma de educação corporativa da Webedia. Nela, nossos colaboradores poderão acessar treinamentos e também desenvolver novas capacitações e conhecimentos relacionados ao nosso negócio.

Diversidade e Inclusão:

Aqui na Webedia, assumimos um compromisso com a diversidade e inclusão. Acreditamos que ambientes diversos e inclusivos favorecem a troca de ideias e nos ajudam a evoluir cada vez mais enquanto empresa. Portanto, buscamos promover a inclusão de pessoas de diferentes gêneros, raças, etnias, orientações sexuais, religiões e etc., em todas as áreas e níveis de carreira da empresa. Temos projetos estruturados, tais como:

  • Comitê de Diversidade - Se reúne semanalmente com o objetivo de promover ações relacionadas à diversidade e inclusão e conta com a participação de um grupo de diferentes raças, gêneros e orientações sexuais, assim como diferentes áreas e níveis de cargo;
  • Letramentos em diversidade - Temos a prática de realizar periodicamente treinamentos com temáticas relacionadas à diversidade e inclusão, tais como: transgeneridade, vieses inconscientes, comunicação inclusiva e representação racial em conteúdos.
  • Núcleos de afinidade - Temos núcleos independentes com diversos assuntos, tais como o núcleo racial, núcleos de pais e mães, núcleos LGBTQIAP+ e o núcleo de mulheres.

A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. Desde 2006 no mercado, conta hoje com a frota mais nova do Brasil e dispõe de lojas nas principais cidades e aeroportos do país. A companhia é reconhecida como uma locadora moderna, alinhada às últimas tendências tecnológicas e que investe em diversificação e renovação de frota, treinamento de funcionários e serviços exclusivos.
Norteada pela devoção em servir, foi pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal e de longo prazo para pessoa física, opções para pré-pagamento e diárias de 27 horas. Focada em tecnologia, também saiu na frente do setor ao oferecer soluções como web check-in, wi-fi no carro, chatbot nas redes sociais e tecnologia de pagamento contactless em todos os veículos.
Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves.
A Movida se diferencia pelo seu "jeitão" inovador e descomplicado. Carrega em seu DNA o foco no cliente e a sua GENTE como prioridade!
Todos os processos seletivos conduzidos pela MOVIDA são afirmativos, inclusivos e não discriminatórios.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responsável por conduzir e entregar o veículo ao cliente, dando suporte e fornecendo as informações de utilizações dos serviços, equipamentos e acessórios do veículo alugado.
  • Ajudar a conduzir o veículo no momento da retirada e devolução do veículo ao cliente;
  • Orientar o cliente no embarque e desembarque, auxiliando-os com seus pertences, equipamentos e bagagens;
  • Instruir sobre a utilização de equipamentos e acessórios específicos dos veículos alugados;
  • Ajudar a trasladar veículos entre lojas e postos de combustíveis e outros prestadores de serviços;
  • Auxiliar na conferência e entrega de documentos de veículos nos processos de locação;
  • Auxiliar na conferência dos veículos da frota, apontando disponibilidade/indisponibilidade e ajudar nos processos de envio de veículos para processos de manutenção;
  • Ajudar a executar procedimentos de recebimento de veículos novos e todas as providências para disponibilização dos mesmos para locação;
  • Abrir, alterar, substituir e fechar contratos no sistema e/ou avulsos.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Possuir CNH B válida e definitiva;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office;
  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente ( área de varejo será um diferencial).

COMPLEMENTO:
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala 6X1;
  • Salário fixo + comissão.

Informações adicionais
GENTE É O NOSSO NEGÓCIO E É POR ISSO QUE VALORIZAMOS NOSSOS COLABORADORES DE DIVERSAS FORMAS!
Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além. Saiba mais!

  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendidas + Kit nascimento para recém-mamães e recém-papais.
  • Sabemos o quanto a educação das crianças e adolescentes é importante. Aqui na MOVIDA, damos aquela ajuda na compra do kit escolar para os filhos da nossa gente.
  • Nossa gente tem acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma de descontos em viagens, cultura e entretenimento, serviços, gastronomia, educação e bem-estar.

description:
Descrição do cargo

A Ultra nasceu acreditando que o esporte e a atividade física são capazes de transformar nós mesmos, o outro e também a sociedade.

Todos nós temos o poder de fazer a diferença. E se o mundo está tão diferente, por que as academias são todas iguais?

Chegamos para fazer diferente.

Existimos para ser uma ferramenta poderosa de transformação através de atividades físicas e esportes. Nascemos como um agente incansável de mudanças, incentivando, motivando e oferecendo a estrutura e serviços adequados para a prática de exercícios.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições do cargo

  • Supervisionar e coordenar a equipe e atividades da unidade.
  • Elaborar relatórios e atualizar indicadores e desempenho da unidade.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho e avaliar a equipe de forma coletiva e individual.
  • Participar, acompanhar e solucionar itens avaliados em auditorias internas.
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe (consultor de vendas, consultor fitness, coach de ginástica, limpeza e manutenção).
  • Acompanhar obras de reparo e equipes de manutenção, tanto predial quanto de equipamentos e limpeza.
  • Realizar pesquisa na região com os concorrentes.
  • Capacitar e desenvolver todos os membros da equipe e de outras unidades.
  • Aplicar treinamentos iniciais e de reciclagem com novos membros e equipe já existente.
  • Responder às manifestações vindas de NPS, SAC, Site, Redes Sociais ou pessoalmente dos alunos, ouvindo, avaliando e decidindo com imparcialidade.
  • Supervisionar o atendimento de toda a equipe.
  • Controlar o estoque e suprimentos da unidade.
  • Coordenar toda a manutenção predial e de equipamentos, solicitar orçamentos e pesquisar melhores preços.
  • Entrevistar e selecionar pessoas para fazer parte da equipe (quando necessário).
  • Participar do processo de admissão de novos membros, receber e conferir os documentos e enviar para contabilidade.
  • Gerenciar o ponto eletrônico da unidade.
  • Auxiliar nos processos administrativos, como admissão, demissão, férias, faltas, marcação de ponto, escala de trabalho, fechamento de folha, etc.
  • Zelar pela conservação, limpeza e ordem no local de trabalho.
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas, conforme necessidade do serviço e orientação do superior imediato.

Grau de Instrução

Ensino superior em Educação Física, desejável graduação adicional em Administração, Gestão de Negócios ou Pessoas.

Habilidades

  • Boa comunicação.
  • Tratamento igualitário.
  • Planejamento e Organização.

Requisitos

  • Gestão de pessoas e processos.

A Katrium Indústrias Químicas S.A. está em busca de um(a) Inspetor(a) de Projetos Mecânicos altamente qualificado(a) e proativo(a) para integrar nossa equipe no Rio de Janeiro! Se você possui paixão por engenharia, busca desafios e quer fazer a diferença em uma empresa líder no setor, esta é a sua oportunidade.
Nesta posição estratégica, você será responsável por desenvolver, planejar e supervisionar a execução de projetos mecânicos, garantindo a excelência e a conformidade com os mais altos padrões de segurança e qualidade. Sua atuação será fundamental para a otimização da produtividade e a inovação em nossas instalações.

  • Desenvolver, planejar e supervisionar a execução de projetos mecânicos, desde a concepção até a entrega final. ️
  • Gerenciar e coordenar equipes próprias e terceirizadas, visando a máxima otimização da produtividade e o cumprimento de prazos.

  • Garantir que a implementação dos projetos priorize a segurança, a sustentabilidade e a economia de energia, mantendo os custos sempre dentro das metas orçamentárias.
  • Conduzir levantamentos e estudos aprofundados sobre as instalações da fábrica, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização.
  • Acompanhar de perto a execução dos serviços de construção e montagem, assegurando a qualidade e a aderência aos projetos.
Venha fazer parte de um time que valoriza a inovação, o desenvolvimento profissional e o impacto positivo!
Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição
  • Experiência comprovada na área de inspeção e gestão de projetos mecânicos.
  • Conhecimento sólido em normas técnicas e regulamentações de segurança industrial.
  • Habilidade em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e projetos mecânicos.
  • Capacidade de gerenciamento de equipes e liderança de projetos.

Entregas e Resultados Esperados Para a Posição
  • Garantir a execução de projetos mecânicos dentro do prazo e orçamento, com zero acidentes e alta qualidade.
  • Otimizar a produtividade das equipes próprias e terceirizadas em pelo menos 15%, através de gestão eficiente.
  • Reduzir custos operacionais dos projetos em 10% por meio de planejamento estratégico e negociação com fornecedores.

  • Implementar melhorias contínuas nos processos de inspeção e execução de projetos, gerando inovação e eficiência.
Sobre a Empresa
A Katrium Indústrias Químicas S.A. é uma empresa líder e inovadora no setor químico, com uma trajetória de sucesso e compromisso com a excelência. Nosso foco está na produção de soluções químicas de alta qualidade, sempre com responsabilidade ambiental e social.

Se você busca uma empresa que investe em tecnologia, sustentabilidade e no bem-estar de sua equipe, a Katrium é o lugar certo para você! Venha fazer parte de um time que constrói o futuro da indústria química no Brasil.

Se você é um profissional comprometido, apaixonado pela área da saúde e segurança e deseja fazer a diferença, o Grupo Med+ é o lugar certo para você!

Somos movidos pela missão de salvar vidas e acreditamos profundamente em nosso propósito de transformar a terceirização de mão de obra no Brasil, convertendo recursos humanos em pessoas felizes.

Somos referência nacional no fornecimento de terceirização de Emergency Response para infraestruturas críticas, atuando em três pilares essenciais: Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho, Urgência e Emergência, Prevenção e combate a incêndios.

A área de Risco tem como objetivo o controle dos riscos de mercado, crédito e liquidez das carteiras, atendendo a todas as empresas do grupo. Cabe ao time também, o controle de todos os limites regulatórios dos fundos.

- Revisão dos relatórios de risco e exposições;

- Acompanhamento de movimentos significativos no risco e os eventos de mercado correspondentes;

- Desenvolvimento de metodologias para controle de risco de mercado, crédito e liquidez, além de limites regulatórios;

- Automatização de processos para o controle de risco;

- Desenvolvimento de metodologias de precificação de ativos e estratégias de hedge.

- Experiência de trabalho em área de Risco ou modelagem financeira;

- Experiência com precificação de ativos financeiros e modelagem de risco de mercado, crédito e liquidez;

- Conhecimento de programação e automação de processos (Python/ SQL);

- Perfil analítico, detalhista e proativo.

Entendemos que investimentos não têm impactos somente financeiros, mas também no futuro do planeta. Temos orgulho de nossa trajetória de mais de 25 anos, e acreditamos na importância de ser a ponte entre diferentes gerações. title: Sr. Procurement Speciaist
description:
About us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.


What you'll do

Ready to drive strategic impact in a global supply chain? We're seeking a Senior Procurement Specialist to join our dynamic team and become the crucial link for our operations in Brazil. This hybrid role offers the unique blend of working collaboratively within our Rio and Macae offices and the flexibility of remote work.

In this pivotal role, you'll be the primary Supply Chain point of contact for key segments doing business across Brazil, including Energy, Enterprise (PLM, ELM, and GFB). You'll master Brazil's unique tools and systems to champion sourcing, optimize supplier management, develop robust commodity strategies, and expertly handle all goods and services purchasing.

If you're a proactive problem-solver with exceptional organizational and project management skills, you'll thrive in prioritizing your workload, communicating status updates, and ensuring strict compliance with all local and national regulations. Fluency in both English and Portuguese is required for this exciting opportunity to shape our procurement landscape in a vital global market. Join us and make a tangible difference!


The day-to-day

  • Execute purchasing tasks using SAP B1 and ServiceNow (SNOW).

  • Provide timely updates and address inquiries from internal stakeholders regarding material status and issues.

  • Communicate with external suppliers to ensure accurate and timely exchange of information.

  • Attend meetings to discuss and disseminate new and existing requirements and schedules.

  • Independently research new suppliers, develop cost-reduction strategies, and present these ideas to key stakeholders.

  • Negotiate with suppliers for improved pricing, terms, and delivery dates.


What you'll need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant experience.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.


What will help you on the job

  • Quickly understand and distill core requirements.

  • Solve problems creatively while adhering to established guidelines.

  • Effectively prioritize and organize work from diverse internal stakeholders.

description:
Product Designer (Relocation to Vietnam)

Join to apply for the Product Designer (Relocation to Vietnam) role at Elfie

Product Designer (Relocation to Vietnam)

3 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Product Designer (Relocation to Vietnam) role at Elfie

Shape the Future of Global Health, from Vietnam

At Elfie, we’re not just building a health tracking app. We’re changing how people manage their health worldwide. If you're looking for a mission with global reach, real impact, and a team that scales fast and learns even faster, you’ve just found your next move.

We provide relocation support to Vietnam for expats, and a seat at the table of one of Asia’s most exciting mobile health-tech companies.

Curious to learn more about our team, culture, and what it's like to relocate to Vietnam?
Click here to find out more on our careers page!

About The Role

As a Product Designer at Elfie, you’ll be at the forefront of shaping how our vision translates into meaningful user and business outcomes. You won’t just design interfaces, you’ll own end-to-end product experiences, from identifying user needs to defining workflows and shaping solutions that drive real impact in healthcare. Collaborating closely with founders, engineers, and data teams, you’ll combine deep user empathy with sharp product thinking to ship features that are intuitive, scalable, and strategically aligned. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on solving complex problems with clarity, care, and craft.

What You’ll Get

  • Permanent Global Contract - With a competitive salary
  • Private Healthcare - From day one
  • Top-Tier Tech Setup - Brand new MacBook + full onboarding kit
  • Career Growth Framework - Clear, personalised, and fast-moving
  • 14 Days PTO + Public Holidays - Real time off
  • Hybrid Working - 3 days in the office per week
  • Refreshments - Free Lunch and Dinner every day for you to enjoy

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with founders and the product team to understand business goals, product vision, and service objectives.
  • Translate ideas into clear, actionable design documentation that supports both product specification and engineering implementation.
  • Research, design, and shape end-to-end product experiences for users across the healthcare ecosystem.
  • Map out user journeys, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs to explore and communicate design solutions throughout the iterative process.
  • Produce prototypes, visual assets, and interface components to support testing and development.
  • Continuously refine and enhance the product experience based on user insights and feedback.

What You’ll Need

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a UI/UX or product design role, with a strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end mobile app design.
  • Proficient in Figma (required), with additional experience in tools like Adobe Suite considered a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects across fast-paced environments with strong planning, time management, and stakeholder alignment skills.
  • Fluent in English, with clear communication and documentation skills
  • Hands-on experience in product development is a bonus, especially in software or tech-focused environments.
  • Proactive, self-motivated mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to dive into details to meet goals.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and adapting designs in an iterative, fast-changing product cycle.
  • Solid foundation in visual design, including drawing, color theory, and layout.
  • Portfolio highlights strong visual craft and ability to solve complex interaction problems.
  • Awareness of current trends in mobile UX/UI and game-inspired interfaces.
    Bonus points for proficiency in Lottie, Rive, or other motion tools.

Why Join Elfie?

We're a global start-up that is mission-led, and fiercely product-driven.

We're building something that improves lives - and we're doing it with a culture of trust, freedom, and high performance.

About Elfie

Elfie is the first completely free, gamified mobile app that rewards users for managing their health. Our goal? To become the world’s largest self-reported medical record platform — across all therapeutic areas.

We operate in 10+ countries today, with plans to expand into 15 by the end of 2025.
Try Elfie for yourself by downloading it onApp Store or Google Play

title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and supporting our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will be responsible for executing upon a customer-centric approach across all of your customer interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with our prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role and at Toptal.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (i.e. Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/ leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Description
The goal of Amazon Logistics is to build a world class last mile operation. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders are delivered quickly, accurately, and in the most cost effective way possible. We are looking for creative leaders with a passion for high complex challenges, a knack for problem solving, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Amazon Logistics is looking for a Learning Coordinator. This position will support operations by preparing new hires to be productive and drive standards adoption.
As Learning Coordinator, you will be responsible for leading onboarding and proficiency programs, driving process standardization and process improvement. You will also perform quality audits and follow up metrics measurement that will drive customer experience and performance improvement within the delivery network.

  • Candidate must be flexible to work weekends and/or overnight, as needed
  • Candidate must have availability to travel up to 15 % of the time
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We not only celebrate the diversity of our workforce, we celebrate the diverse ways we work. If you would like to request an accommodation for the interview or onboarding process, please let our team know and we will connect you to our accommodation team.
Key job responsibilities
  • Lead Learning Trainers and Learning Ambassadors.
  • Create and manage operational onboarding programs.
  • Track new hires operational productivity and guarantee learning curve improvement
  • Manage peak onboarding plan with main stakeholders
  • Mentor Amazon staff in lean principles and drive adoption of standard work processes into the daily work and habits of the operations.
  • Support network level excellence in six sigma and lean practices through designing and implementing processes, metrics, and the proper usage of systems.
  • Lever from Best at Amazon (BAA) practices to support process improvements, best practice sharing, and standardization of the work routine.
Basic Qualifications
  • Completed Bachelor’s Degree
  • Operations Background
  • Experience leading, teaching and developing people to deliver key organizational goals
  • Excellent communication skills, ability to simplify complex topics for broad audiences
  • Cross-functional project management experience
  • Experience using and communicating performance metrics
  • Advanced Excel and anaytical skills
  • Fluent Portuguese and Intermediate English
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelors’ Degree in Engineering, Operations or related field as well as a MBA is a plus
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems and content development.
  • Ability to influence others without having positional authority
  • Certifications in Six Sigma and Lean are a plus
  • Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgment in stressful situations
  • Ability to Deep Dive and develop innovative ideas for process challenges
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems and content development, ADDIE and 6D certification Ability to influence others without having positional authority

Benefícios incluem assistência médica e odontológica, ginástica laboral, seguro de vida, vale-alimentação/refeição, vale-transporte, Gympass/Totalpass e auxílio creche.

Description
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Department: Partnerships & Media

Location: Brazil

Description
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Senior Partnership Development Manager will be responsible for driving sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets. The role requires deep market knowledge, and a robust network in the region.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Source, qualify, and engage potential sponsors, securing meetings and presenting tailored partnership proposals to major regional and international brands.
  • Develop bespoke sponsorship packages that address the unique needs and objectives of prospective partners.
  • Lead negotiations through to successful acquisition, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s commercial guidelines and values.
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Establish and nurture long-term relationships with key sponsor prospects, ensuring continuity and value beyond the tournament.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Junior CMMS Engineer, Maintenance and Inventory
description:
Press Tab to Move to Skip to Content Link

Junior CMMS Engineer, Maintenance and Inventory

Date Posted: 31 Jul 2025

Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Job Summary:

As a Junior CMMS Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring optimal maintenance and inventory processes within our Offshore Production business unit.

This position requires not only strong analytical and communication skills but also a hands-on approach to supporting end users and maintaining system data integrity.

You will be a key contributor to our continuous improvement initiatives, working collaboratively with various teams to enhance our operations

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide ongoing support for Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) activities across all operating assets in Brazil, fostering a seamless operational environment.
  • Deliver hands-on training to end-users on IFS CMMS and related maintenance and inventory processes, ensuring their competence and confidence in utilising the system.
  • Monitor CMMS system usage, advocate best practices, and implement efficiencies to protect the integrity and functionality of the system.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and enhancement of Maintenance & Inventory KPIs across Brazil’s operational units, providing insight that drives performance.
  • Support the Functional Manager and Operational Managers in analysing maintenance and inventory performance, facilitating informed decision-making.
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency within the CMMS, collaborating effectively with team members to uphold high standards.
  • Actively participate as a member of the Support Issue team, executing tasks and responsibilities related to maintenance and inventory support.
  • Advocate for the use of CMMS, underscoring the importance of defined processes, tools, and standards within the team and broader organisation.

Duties:

  • Participate actively in meetings as required, engaging with the ALM Maintenance and Inventory team to foster collaboration and communication.
  • Conduct regular reviews and analyses of maintenance-related KPIs for Brazilian units, identifying areas for improvement and driving operational excellence.
  • Perform both offshore and onshore site visits as necessary to aid in system usage and facilitate training opportunities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support integrated processes that encompass maintenance and inventory management.
  • Provide necessary budget input to asset Operation Managers as required, ensuring financial prudence within the Brazil units.
  • Carry out additional tasks and responsibilities as required, contributing to the broader goals of the department.

Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Structural, Mechanical, Marine, or Offshore Engineering, or equivalent education and relevant industry experience.
  • Experience in the offshore maintenance industry, specifically with comparable ERP systems, with preference given to those who have worked with IFS.
  • Experience in strategy optimisation is advantageous, enabling you to influence process improvements effectively.
  • Proven experience in working in a global environment, collaborating successfully with diverse teams.

Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, capable of addressing complex challenges effectively.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills that foster collaboration and respect across teams.
  • Exceptional organisational and administrative skills, with a keen attention to quality, detail, and the ability to prioritise effectively.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industry standards and regulations, ensuring compliance at every level of operation.

Join our dynamic team at Yinson and contribute to shaping the future of offshore production. We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where diverse perspectives are valued and innovation is encouraged. We look forward to seeing how your unique skills and experiences can enhance our operations.

If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!

title: Senior Software Business Analyst
description:
Job Description


Mentor Mate creates durable technical solutions that deliver digital transformation at scale by blending strategic insights and thoughtful design with brilliant engineering. With mature and established practices in enterprise web and mobile development, quality engineering, technical architecture, human-centered design, cloud, DevOps, data, and analytics, the company provides challenging careers in a friendly and global people-oriented environment. We value every team member and share our success through flexible working models, competitive pay and benefits, and advancement opportunities.

As part of global technology company Tietoevry Create, MentorMate enables people to work on impactful, global projects for recognizable brands and grow their careers in a team of over 10,000 experts.

About the role

The Software Business Analyst team members are an integral part of the MentorMate structure and as such you will be given the unique opportunity to participate in a variety of projects, work on different business domains, collaborate with all departments in the company, influence our clients, and participate in their decision-making process. You'll work together with cross-functional teams to identify requirements, design solutions, and implement new systems. You'll also be responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders and providing strategic insights to drive business growth.

About the team

Our Business Analysts are an integral part of our company structure and have the unique opportunity to enter various projects, work in different business domains, collaborate with all departments in the company, influence our clients, and participate in their decision-making process. They work with cross-functional teams to identify requirements, design solutions, and implement new systems while providing strategic insights to drive business growth.

In this role, you will

  • Conduct in-depth discussions with clients to deeply understand their business, processes, and services.

  • Forge strong stakeholder relationships, guiding them to optimize business value.

  • Identify improvement opportunities and propose solutions to streamline business processes

  • Lead business analysis activities during project definition, capturing high-level requirements from key stakeholders.

  • Drive requirement elicitation meetings, ensuring consensus.

  • Working closely with the Design team for the preparation of user research

  • Partner with solutions architects to analyze and document the business requirements

  • Collaborate with clients and cross-functional teams to define business requirements and design technology solutions

  • Work with the project management team to ensure quality and on-time delivery of projects by monitoring progress and managing risks and issues

  • Produce and maintain project documentation such as business requirements, functional specifications, functional requirements, diagrams, etc.

  • Create well-defined epics and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.

  • Support product owners in story scoping and prioritization, aligning development with business goals.

  • Validate the requirements with the development team

  • Lead SCRUM meetings such as sprint planning, backlog refinement, and estimation

  • Support sprint objectives and prioritize tasks effectively.

  • Create and decompose Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs) into actionable user stories.

Our ideal candidate profile:

  • 5+ years in IT, with a minimum of 3 years as an analyst.

  • Good knowledge of business analysis best practices and ability to effectively apply them

  • Ability to analyze complex dispersed information and synthesize it in concise product requirements

  • Ability to understand and organize complex ideas into application requirements

  • Familiar with requirement tracking tools (like JIRA, Trello, or similar).

  • Experienced in diagramming tools (Lucidchart, Visio, Miro, etc.).

  • Experience in preparing user stories, understanding and communicating business processes, and value

  • Experience in creating valuable articulate requirements and complex process flows

  • Agile methodology expertise.

  • Ability to identify risks in the project and communicate them

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to assert themselves in meetings, both internally and with clients

  • Ability to deal with rapidly varying tasks as needed

  • Focus on Design Thinking will be considered an advantage

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills as well as excellent communication and presentation skills

  • Must be comfortable creating and working with TRDs and translating them into user stories.

  • Experience working with data and infrastructure-focused projects is required

Additional Information


At Tietoevry, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation.Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Job Summary:

As a Senior Manager of Enterprise Operations at Toptal, you will drive cross-functional initiatives that support strategic direction, execution frameworks, workflow optimization, KPI development, and scalable team structures needed to fuel Toptal’s growth. Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Operations, you will act as a trusted advisor to tackle complex, high-impact challenges and contribute directly to outcomes that matter while partnering closely with senior leaders across the organization.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

Working within our Customer team, you will scope initiatives, develop structured approaches, and help build comprehensive strategies to meet key objectives—delivering them with precision. You’ll collaborate with leaders and stakeholders to enable successful execution of major company initiatives that may result in new offerings, enhanced systems, or more efficient processes. Your ability to quickly understand the business, influence key decision-makers, develop actionable recommendations, and follow through to execution will define your impact. Upon delivery, you’ll continue to support or co-own the initiative to drive ongoing improvement and long-term value.

The life cycle of your projects will look like this: Approach initiatives with a consultant’s mindset—ask smart questions, learn quickly, and understand the broader business context. Think beyond constraints and develop frameworks that can enable significant impact, not just incremental change. Execute directly where needed and build infrastructure that can scale. Post-launch, ensure long-term sustainability by embedding processes and best practices that can live beyond you.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.

  • You must be a hands-on contributor. This is not a role for directing from the sidelines.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
O profissional irá compor a equipe de estudos elétricos do Cepel, atuando no desenvolvimento de estudos de fluxo de potência, análises de curto-circuito e estudos de estabilidade eletromecânica, envolvendo os softwares Anarede, Anafas e Anatem. Poderá realizar ainda estudos de viabilidade técnico econômica de alternativas para expansão do sistema de transmissão e para integração de novos empreendimentos ao SIN. Realizará estudos calculando também margens de transmissão de potência e margens de escoamento em barramentos do SIN. Desenvolverá estudos de interligação de plataformas de petróleo offshore, viabilizando a otimização da geração do sistema. Também atuará escrevendo relatórios e artigos técnicos sobre o tema.

  • Nível superior completo em engenharia elétrica, com ênfase em sistemas de potência.
  • Experiência em estudos elétricos de integração de novos empreendimentos ao Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN) e domínio dos softwares do CEPEL: Anarede, Anafas e Anatem.
  • Experiência na modelagem em CDU para simulações dinâmicas no Anatem.
  • Conhecedor de linguagens de programação, como VBA ou Phyton.

Cepel
O Centro de Pesquisas de Energia Elétrica (Cepel), fundado pela Eletrobras em 1974, é a maior instituição de P&D do setor elétrico na América Latina. Com mais de cinco décadas de atuação, é referência como Instituição Científica, Tecnológica e de Inovação (ICT), sem fins lucrativos, combinando um corpo técnico de excelência a uma infraestrutura laboratorial de classe mundial. Presente em todo o Brasil e em nove países, o Cepel desenvolve tecnologias e serviços para geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização de energia elétrica, promovendo avanços que tornam o setor mais eficiente e confiável. Suas soluções estratégicas abrangem projetos de P&D, consultoria técnica, serviços laboratoriais e tecnologias para planejamento, operação e gestão de sistemas elétricos, além de impulsionar redes mais resilientes e fortalecer a matriz energética nacional.

description:
Netvagas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Netvagas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona.
Nascemos para transformar a forma como as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos.
Essa é uma vaga para quem tem perfil analítico, comprometimento com a qualidade das entregas e interesse genuíno por processos contábeis. Aqui, você será uma peça-chave na conexão entre os dados financeiros, a equipe interna e as obrigações fiscais, garantindo que tudo aconteça de forma precisa, fluida e alinhada com as normas contábeis.
A sua missão será garantir a integridade, precisão e conformidade das informações contábeis, contribuindo para a confiabilidade dos relatórios financeiros e para a tomada de decisão baseada em dados consistentes.
Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar lançamentos contábeis e conciliações de contas patrimoniais e de resultado, assegurando conformidade com as normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC) e internacionais (IFRS);
  • Apoiar na elaboração das demonstrações financeiras e de relatórios gerenciais, garantindo a consistência e a integridade das informações;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com outras áreas da empresa, recebendo e analisando informações para posterior registro e tratamento contábil;
  • Dar suporte na elaboração de notas explicativas e nas demonstrações financeiras oficiais da companhia;
  • Atuar de forma proativa na melhoria contínua dos processos contábeis, com foco em controle, eficiência e conformidade (compliance);
  • Preparar e colaborar na entrega das obrigações acessórias, como ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital) e ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal).
O que esperamos de você:
Experiências e Habilidades
  • Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis, com registro ativo no CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade);
  • Domínio avançado do Excel, com capacidade de utilizar fórmulas e ferramentas para análise de dados contábeis;
  • Proatividade, dinamismo e com interesse em aprender e se desenvolver continuamente na área contábil;
  • Experiência comprovada em rotinas de fechamento contábil e conciliações de contas;
  • Ter conhecimento no sistema Totvs será considerado um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos em contabilidade de custos também serão valorizados.
Seu Jeito De Trabalhar
  • Colaborativo, sabendo atuar bem em equipe, com escuta ativa e abertura para diferentes pontos de vista.
  • Você se comunica de forma transparente e objetiva, contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança e alinhamento.
  • É comprometido com os prazos, responsabilidades e entregas, demonstrando senso de dono no dia a dia.
  • Organizado, com capacidade de manter o controle das tarefas e informações mesmo em momentos de alta demanda.
  • Proativo, sempre buscando antecipar necessidades, propor melhorias e resolver problemas com autonomia.
  • Tem empatia no relacionamento com colegas e outras áreas, entendendo as necessidades do outro e colaborando de forma respeitosa.
  • E também é atento aos detalhes, garantindo qualidade e precisão em tudo o que entrega.
É importante destacar: essa é uma vaga para atuar dentro do time de Contabilidade, com foco em rotinas contábeis e operacionais. A função exige organização, atenção aos detalhes e autonomia para lidar com diferentes áreas da empresa com clareza, consistência e agilidade.
Bora?Se você quer estar nos bastidores das decisões financeiras de uma empresa com propósito, garantindo controle, precisão e compliance nos processos contábeis, essa vaga é para você.

title: Placement Matching Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
About Virtual Internships

We’re on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting our VI-P Guide , which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

  1. Coletar dados sobre preços, promoções e exposição de produtos em diferentes pontos de venda;
  2. Observar práticas comerciais, apresentação das lojas e comportamento de mercado;

  4. Apoiar análises e relatórios para as áreas de planejamento e comercial.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Excel básico;
  • Disponibilidade para atividades externas no estado do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Boa comunicação, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade.

A gente ama contar e ouvir histórias. Vem conhecer um pouquinho da nossa casa.

Estamos desde 1932 nas receitas e memórias de muitas famílias cariocas! E quando a gente para pra lembrar… Quantas boas histórias. Da avó que comprava temperos, ao filho que não dispensa uma boa esfiha. Aí chegaram os netos, bisnetas… Aqui, a turma é grande, sempre reunida.

Nós acreditamos que o segredo para mantermos a nossa casa por mais de 80 anos é acreditar na nossa gente e buscar sempre o melhor para o nosso cliente. É com esses dois valores que estamos diariamente de portas e braços abertos oferecendo o melhor atendimento e, é claro, todos os produtos que você precisar. Afinal, se não tem aqui, não tem em lugar nenhum!

Job description

O Enfermeiro Plantonista, atua na assistência de enfermagem baseada no processo de enfermagem, com avaliação inicial, diagnóstico e prescrição de enfermagem, execução do plano terapêutico e acompanhamento da evolução.

Realiza a educação em saúde ao binômio paciente e familiar/cuidador com objetivo de preparar para a desospitalização do hospital de transição;

Esclarece os pacientes e familiares sobre dúvidas, referentes a seus direitos e deveres relacionados à assistência prestada durante o período de internação


Main responsibilities

Receber e/ou passar plantão, informando-se do estado de saúde de cada paciente, verificando o funcionamento dos equipamentos, identificando as ocorrências e anormalidades do período, verificando pacientes em sedação controlada, cuidados no fim da vida em controle de dor, assegurando o fluxo de realização de exames, a fim de prover informações seguras dos pacientes e priorizar a assistência a ser prestada;

Realizar procedimentos gerais e específicos de enfermagem, tais como aprazamento e administração de medicamentos, instalação de soro e sondas, coleta de materiais diversos para análise laboratorial, monitorização hemodinâmica não invasiva, verificação, controle e registro dos sinais vitais, controle e manipulação de cateteres, drenos e sondas, auxilio no processo de reanimação cardiorrespiratória, punção de veias e artérias, administração de antifúngicos, acompanhamento da instalação e infusão de hemocomponentes, execução de curativos; indicação, manipulação e avaliação de cateteres, estomas, lesões cutâneas, controle e administração de fármacos e acompanhamento na realização de exames;

Orientar, acompanhar e liderar as atividades executadas pelo Técnico de Enfermagem, indicando os cuidados a serem observados na realização das atribuições, identificando fatores de risco e sinais de doenças ocupacionais da equipe de enfermagem.

Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem;

description:
Job type: Full-time employee

Somos movidos por muita Energia, segurança, responsabilidade socioambiental e grandes desafios. Acreditamos na diversidade como uma grande aliada da transformação cultural. Por isso, buscamos pessoas que gostem e se dediquem a aprender constantemente.

Se você quer fazer parte da 4ª maior usina hidrelétrica do Brasil e se identifica com o nosso negócio e os nossos valores, inscreva-se em nossas vagas! =)

Responsabilidades:

  1. Acompanhar e analisar os aspectos legais tributários estratégicos para a companhia.
  2. Avaliar e utilizar os benefícios fiscais, analisando os impactos no planejamento tributário e financeiro da companhia.
  3. Realizar a apuração de impostos (PIS, COFINS, IR e CSLL) e o SPED Fiscal.
  4. Mapear, acompanhar e implantar os impactos tributários em função da Reforma Tributária, atuando como interface entre clientes internos e externos.
  5. Elaborar e analisar relatórios fiscais para garantir conformidade com leis e regulamentações.
  6. Realizar apresentações e reports à gerência, diretoria e acionistas.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Experiência no setor elétrico.
  • Vasta experiência com obrigações acessórias.
  • Larga experiência em apuração fiscal e aproveitamento de benefícios fiscais.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Benefícios:

  • VA e/ou VR (cartão Ticket) - saldo dividido entre os dois cartões, para restaurantes ou supermercado.
  • Plano de Saúde nacional, 100% subsidiado para você e dependentes.
  • Plano odontológico coberto para você e dependentes.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças até 5 anos.
  • Gympass para cuidados com o corpo.
  • Ginástica Laboral para alongamento.
  • Previdência Privada com contribuição da empresa até 7%.

Sobre a Jirau Energia:

A Jirau Energia é uma Sociedade de Propósito Específico com acionistas ENGIE, Eletrobrás e Mitsui. Integrante do complexo hidrelétrico do Rio Madeira, é considerada a 4ª maior geradora de energia elétrica do Brasil, com capacidade instalada de 3750MW. A energia gerada é limpa e renovável, atendendo grande parte da demanda nacional, contribuindo para o crescimento industrial e desenvolvimento regional.

Desde o início da operação, já gerou mais de 141 milhões de MWh de energia, reduzindo cerca de seis milhões de toneladas de carbono por ano através do Mecanismo de Desenvolvimento Limpo da ONU. A usina oferece o melhor índice de disponibilidade entre as hidrelétricas de grande porte do país, maximizando o aproveitamento das águas do Rio Madeira.

Fundada em valores como ética, segurança, integridade, comprometimento, confiança e senso de dono, a empresa promove o desenvolvimento sustentável, valorização dos recursos humanos, diversidade e inclusão, além da conservação dos recursos naturais e patrimônio cultural.

title: [REMOTE] Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist (Brazil)
description:
Join a High-Performance Startup Focused on Building the Future of AI-Driven Paid Acquisition Performance Marketing

At WKND, we’re not just another agency—we’re shaping a tech-driven future where AI-powered solutions revolutionize how brands acquire and retain customers. While we currently excel as a performance marketing and creative strategy firm, our long-term vision is to develop scalable software platforms that help eCommerce brands maximize their growth, profitability, and brand loyalty.

We don’t follow trends—we create them. Our approach is anchored in speed, innovation, and execution at the highest level, redefining performance and retention marketing in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

Relentless Pursuit of Excellence

At WKND, excellence isn’t optional—it’s our standard. We have cultivated a performance-first culture where outcomes reign supreme. Whether it takes three hours or three hundred, our goal remains the same: deliver world-class results with a tangible impact. Every team member is empowered to think critically, act decisively, and solve complex problems at scale. This is not a place for those seeking routine—it’s for those who thrive under pressure and are driven by transformative outcomes.

Innovation at Speed

We exist to outpace the speed of innovation in our industry. WKND’s work culture is defined by accountability, speed, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We don’t just meet expectations—we exceed them. By leveraging advanced AI and automation, we craft data-driven marketing strategies that deliver measurable ROI for our clients while setting new standards in acquisition and retention.

Uncompromising Standards

Our team acts with a founder’s mentality—taking full ownership of their work and upholding exceptionally high standards. Collaboration, precision, and simplicity fuel our execution. Every process we design is built to scale without unnecessary complexity, ensuring each solution is as potent as it is elegant.

Customer-Centric Mission

Our clients’ success is our driving force. We are obsessed with creating exceptional experiences that empower global DTC brands to attract, convert, and retain customers at scale. From high-performing ad campaigns and creative iterations to AI-driven marketing solutions, we’re laser-focused on delivering strategies that surpass expectations and fuel sustained growth.

Visionary Thinking

At WKND, we don’t just look at where marketing stands today—we anticipate where it’s going tomorrow. We operate with a forward-thinking mindset, exploring how AI and emerging tech will reshape both acquisition and retention strategies over the next decade. Join us in laying the foundation for the future of eCommerce growth.

This is your chance to be part of a team where excellence is non-negotiable, and rewards are directly tied to performance. If you’re ready to tackle challenges, push boundaries, and define the future of data-driven marketing, WKND is where you belong. We don’t just aim to compete—we aim to lead.

The Power of Communication

At WKND, clear, proactive communication is the backbone of our high-performance culture. We believe in staying ahead of potential issues rather than reacting after problems arise. By sharing insights, challenges, and wins early and often, we maintain transparency, solve complex problems faster, and keep our teams fully aligned. This approach fosters accountability not just within individual departments but across the entire organization—everyone owns their deliverables while working cohesively toward common objectives.

As a consultative expert , you will bridge the gap between our internal strategies and our external partners’ growth initiatives and business goals. This involves active listening —genuinely hearing and understanding each stakeholder’s perspective, then offering thoughtful recommendations that drive both short-term impact and long-term success. By practicing intentional thought partnership and close collaboration, you’ll build strong, trusting relationships that ensure our clients feel heard, supported, and set up for success. Ultimately, this culture of open dialogue and empathy elevates everyone’s contributions—enabling us to deliver world-class outcomes at speed.

Why Join WKND?

  • Build Innovative SaaS Solutions
    Contribute to developing scalable software designed for global eCommerce markets.
  • Solve Mission-Critical Challenges
    Address complex acquisition and business challenges using AI-powered tools that drive efficiency, engagement, and ROI.
  • Pace of Innovation
    Operate at the cutting edge of AI technology, where bold thinking and agility are the keys to success.
  • Performance-Based Rewards
    Benefit from a competitive compensation structure with stock options, directly aligning your growth with our company’s trajectory.
  • Relentless Pursuit of Excellence
    Collaborate with a team that values meaningful outcomes over mere effort and recognizes truly exceptional results.

Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. You’ll execute and optimize campaigns across major social platforms, ensuring they meet and exceed performance targets while aligning with broader marketing initiatives. With your strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate creative, retention, and conversion rate optimization efforts into cohesive campaigns.

This role offers a clear path to leadership – you’ll work alongside our Paid Media Manager (PMM) to accomplish key business objectives and initiatives, positioning yourself for future growth into roles like Paid Media Manager. If you’re a data-savvy, innovative marketer passionate about leveraging AI and rapid experimentation to scale DTC brands, this opportunity is your next big challenge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Paid Social Campaign Execution & Optimization: Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms (e.g., Facebook/Instagram, TikTok) to drive customer acquisition and retention. Implement audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and bidding strategies, continuously A/B testing creatives and audience approaches to maximize engagement and conversions. Ensure all campaigns align with client goals and WKND’s performance benchmarks for measurable outcomes.
  • Full-Funnel Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align paid social initiatives with broader direct-to-consumer growth strategies, ensuring a cohesive full-funnel approach from prospecting to retention. Work closely with creative, email/SMS, conversion rate optimization, SEO, and content teams to integrate campaign efforts and share insights. Ensure consistent messaging and leverage cross-channel learnings to improve marketing efficiency and customer lifetime value.
  • Data Analysis & KPI Management: Leverage advanced analytics platforms and AI-driven tools to monitor campaign performance and inform optimizations. Track and analyze key metrics – including return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing efficiency ratio (MER), click-through rate (CTR), average order value (AOV), and CAC-to-LTV ratio – adjusting budgets and strategy to exceed targets. Use data-driven insights to make timely optimizations that improve ROI and scale results.
  • Insightful Reporting & Presentations: Compile and present detailed performance reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Create visually compelling presentations for internal teams and clients, highlighting campaign results, trends, and strategic recommendations. Communicate the story behind the numbers, enabling informed decision-making and demonstrating the value of our paid social efforts.
  • Client Communication Support: Support the Paid Media Manager in delivering top-notch client service through effective communication. Participate in occasional client calls or meetings to provide updates, explain campaign performance, and answer questions with professionalism and clarity. Help maintain transparent, trusting relationships by ensuring clients understand campaign progress and value.
  • Strategic Initiative Execution: Partner with the PMM to execute key business initiatives and special projects in paid media. Translate high-level objectives into actionable campaign plans and take ownership of their successful implementation. Proactively contribute ideas and optimizations that drive business goals, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • AI-Driven Innovator: You’re passionate about leveraging AI and automation to push the limits of what's possible, always looking for ways to deliver scalable, cutting-edge solutions that drive success.
  • Tech Visionary: You thrive in environments that challenge you to innovate, embracing new technologies and harnessing them to create transformative, future-proof SaaS platforms.
  • Creative Problem Solver: You’re not afraid to think outside the box, tackling complex challenges with fresh perspectives and finding solutions that have a lasting impact.
  • Collaborative Team Player: You excel in communicating complex ideas clearly, working seamlessly across teams, and contributing to a culture of open collaboration to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Results-Oriented & Data-Driven: You’re obsessed with data, continuously interpreting metrics to relentlessly optimize campaigns and drive unparalleled ROI. You’re not just meeting targets—you’re exceeding them.
  • Platform Proficiency & Digital Mastery: You’re a wizard across paid platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, and more, with a sharp understanding of AI-driven optimization tools that push performance to new heights.
  • Proactive & Adaptable: You’re always ahead of the curve, staying on top of platform changes and anticipating challenges before they arise. You pivot with agility, turning potential obstacles into growth opportunities

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field (required) .
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience in paid social (required) , with a deep understanding of paid acquisition and media buying strategies. Proven ability to scale campaigns, manage substantial budgets, and consistently meet or exceed key performance targets.
  • Technical Skills: Highly knowledgeable in bidding and targeting automation tools; proficient in Google Analytics and other ad management/testing platforms.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent project management and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to structure complex, multi-stakeholder projects effectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills for both client-facing and internal collaboration.
  • Performance Culture: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and effective time-management.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Base Salary: Calibrated to attract top talent who thrive under high expectations.
  • Generous Stock Options: Align your success with the company’s trajectory and shared prosperity.
  • Performance-Based Bonuses: Earn additional rewards for surpassing key growth milestones and metrics.
  • Access to Advanced Development Tools & Resources: Stay on the cutting edge with the latest AI-driven marketing technologies.
  • High-Performance Culture: Be part of a team where your contributions are noticed, celebrated, and rewarded for driving real impact.
  • Healthcare & Wellness Options (available upon request): Designed to support your well-being and peace of mind.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work remotely or in-office, as long as you meet deadlines and deliver exceptional results.

Ready to Shape the Future of Paid Acquisition & Paid Social — And Revolutionize with AI?

Join WKND as a Senior Paid Social Acquisition Specialist and become a pivotal force behind high-performing, AI-enhanced campaigns for top DTC brands. You won’t just execute ads—you’ll help shape strategy, pioneer new approaches in paid social, and contribute to our bold shift toward an AI-driven SaaS model.

If you’re passionate about delivering transformative outcomes, driving exponential growth, and advancing your career in a cutting-edge environment, WKND is where you belong .
Apply now to join our high-performance team, harness AI-driven insights, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in digital marketing. Together, we’ll redefine eCommerce growth and achieve exceptional results for our clients.

description:
Reboot Monkey is seeking an experienced Technical Recruiter with advanced headhunting skills and LinkedIn proficiency to recruit Data Center Engineers and Technicians worldwide .   • Headhunting & Talent Acquisition :

    • Manage the entire recruitment process including job posting, sourcing, interviewing, offer negotiation, and onboarding for technical positions.
